RoleDefinition.name: MOTHER_MAID
RoleDefinition.description: Dedicated maternal care, daily hygiene, meal supervision, and assigned room children monitoring.

RoleDefinition.name: WAITER
RoleDefinition.description: Dining hall food distribution, meal serving records, tableware sanitation, and mealtime discipline.

RoleDefinition.name: COOK
RoleDefinition.description: Kitchen management, meal preparation according to weekly approved menu, and ration consumption logging.

RoleDefinition.name: COOK_HELPER
RoleDefinition.description: Kitchen assistant for vegetable preparation, dough kneading, dishwashing, and ration fetching.

RoleDefinition.name: SWEEPER
RoleDefinition.description: Campus sanitation, hostel rooms cleanliness, hygiene maintenance, and waste management.

RoleDefinition.name: SECURITY_GUARD
RoleDefinition.description: Main gate access control, visitor registry, shift security surveillance, and child safety.

RoleDefinition.name: DRIVER
RoleDefinition.description: Approved institutional transport, school pick and drop, and official movement support.

RoleDefinition.name: QARI_QARIA
RoleDefinition.description: Religious education, Quran instruction, and supervised learning activities.

RoleDefinition.name: INCHARGE
RoleDefinition.description: Project Director / Head of Sweet Home Multan with complete institutional, administrative, and financial authority.

RoleDefinition.name: ACCOUNT_ASSISTANT
RoleDefinition.description: Full operational ERP access over Accounts, Procurement, Inventory, Ration, Children, and Staff records.

RoleDefinition.name: HR_REPRESENTATIVE
RoleDefinition.description: Human Resources management, staff profiles, duty rosters, attendance tracking, and institutional correspondence.

RoleDefinition.name: CLERK
RoleDefinition.description: Admissions, orphan child profiles, document verification, academic records, and hostel bed allocations.
